title: Lake Tillery Boat Rentals

Lake Tillery is a 5,000-acre lake with wildlife and nearby outdoor activities
Must be 26 years or older and have a valid driver's license
Boating safety education required if born on or after Jan 1, 1988, to operate boat 10 hp or more

includes: USCG safety equipment including life jackets
Map of the area and helpful tips
blurb: Tillery Boat Rentals offers pontoon boats for 3-12 passengers with features like bimini tops and fishing equipment. Rentals operate from Lilly's Bridge Marina on Lake Tillery, a 5,000-acre lake with nearby outdoor activities. They also offer The Lilly Pad, a floating rental home that sleeps up to 8 people with lake views and amenities.
extraNote: $ deposit required to hold rental; 50% deposit required for holidays · Reservations over 100 days out may not reflect final price; holiday pricing applies · Boats must be returned by 6pm; fuel must be paid on site at marina · Multi-day and weekday discounts available; military and first responders get 10% off · Damage or lost equipment costs charged immediately upon return · Bookings changed more than twice incur $100 fee; changes allowed one month in advance or due to weather · Lilly's Bridge Marina
